output.name: Thorna — The Gaff
output.myth: In high summer the big fish come up through the strait, the ones with teeth like bone combs, and they tear a net faster than a child can count knots. My grandmother's mother said the first gaff was made by Ennu from a whalebone rib and a length of ash. Ennu gave it to Aun, who was never good at waiting. Aun leaned over the gunwale to see how deep the strait went, and Tavo came along laughing and filled the sail, and the fish came up all at once. Aun hooked one, and the gaff hooked him too, and the two of them hung above the water while Tavo laughed himself hoarse. Varosk, the grey hound Aun left on the shore, rang his teeth like bells and barked until the haulers looked up. Kael cast for the fallen stars and caught nothing, as always, but he saw the gaff and kept quiet. Hesk counted the hauls and found one short. So when the big ones run, the gaff goes up over the strait, and we haul carefully, because Aun is still on the end of it.
output.finding: Start at Lamet, the Name-Kite, and move your eye a fist and a half east along the Lamp Road to find Thorna, the Gaff.
